Change Form.Description: Bond a spren during a Highstorm and change form.

Opportunist.Description: Once per round when rolling a plot die, you can reroll, use the new result.

Watchful Eye.Description: Use Opportunist on willing allie's plot die within 20ft.

Forms of Finesse.Description: Gain Artform (awareness +1, expertise in Painting and Music, advantage on crafting and entertainment tests) and nimbleform

Breathe Stormlight.Description: Breathe Investiture up to your maximum value. You must have a sphere count of up to 3 times your maximum Investiture.

Enhance.Description: Spend 1 Investiture point to gain Strength +1 and Speed +1, spend a ▷ and 1 Investiture at the end of each turn to maintain this condition.

Regenerate.Description: Recover health equal to 1d6 + your tier; you can use this free action even if you are unconscious.

First Ideal.Description: Acquire the talents: Breathe Stormlight, Enhance, Regenerate. Complete the objective «Speak the First Ideal» to unlock more abilities.

Strike: Sidesword.Description: Attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 1d6 keen damage. Hit: 1d6 + 6 keen damage. Quickdraw: You can use a ▷ to draw this weapon. Off-hand (Expertise): Attacking with this weapon while it is in your off-hand costs 1 focus instead of 2.

Strike: Knife.Description: Attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 1d4 keen damage. Hit: 1d4 + 6 keen damage. Discreet: You gain advantage on any test to not have this weapon taken from you.

Strike: Sling.Description: Attack +6, reach [30/120] ft., one target. Graze: 1d4 impact damage. Hit: 1d4 + 6 impact damage. Discreet: You gain advantage on any test to not have this weapon taken from you.
